neighbours.label: The second element of a compound whose first element is a count word: ' speed' after 'single', 'fuel' after 'multi-', '-tone' after 'two'. A list of specific compounds: other count compounds (three-stage, dual-mode) and the bare nouns stay quiet
fire: My brother converted his old road frame into a single speed commuter.
The race has a separate category for single speed riders.
The army ordered trucks with a multi-fuel power plant.
The stove is a multi-fuel model that burns wood or coal.
He wore two-tone shoes to the wedding.
The kitchen has two-tone cabinets in grey and white.
She prefers a single speed drivetrain because it needs little care.
The generator uses a multi-fuel carburetor for remote sites.
quiet: My brother converted his old road frame into a fast commuter.
The race has a separate category for high speed descents.
The army ordered trucks with a diesel fuel tank.
The stove is an old model that burns fuel slowly.
He wore brown shoes to the wedding and spoke in a low tone.
The kitchen has three-door cabinets in grey and white.
She prefers a dual-mode drivetrain because it needs little care.
The launcher uses a three-stage booster for remote orbits.

notes: Card: ' speed' x4 (single speed), 'uel' x2 (multi-fuel), '-tone' x2, 'peed' (multispeed), Russian odno-tip. Probes: 'single speed bike' 0.88, 'multi-fuel engine' 0.79, 'two-tone paint' 0.58; 'top speed' 0.01, 'diesel fuel' 0.08, 'three-stage ... dual-mode' 0.07. The general pattern (any count-prefix compound) did not hold in probes, so the label keeps the list.
